postop_diagnosis_text: M48.062 (Lumbar spinal stenosis w/ neurogenic claudication) (Unlinked to secondary CC/MCC in problem list)
unstructured_op_note_narrative: OPERATIVE REPORT: Patient underwent complex revision posterior lumbar decompression and interbody arthrodesis at L4-L5 AND L5-S1. Dense, adherent epidural scar tissue from prior laminectomy required 159 additional minutes of microscopic neurolysis under Carl Zeiss Pentero microscope. An incidental 4mm ventral durotomy at L5-S1 was repaired primarily with 6-0 Prolene and overlaid with DuraGen matrix. Two titanium interbody cages were impacted at L4-L5 and L5-S1 with local autograft and DBM. Continuous SSEP/EMG neuromonitoring performed throughout.
documented_intraop_complications: Accidental dural tear (G97.41) repaired w/ DuraGen; dense epidural adhesions

postop_diagnosis_text: M43.16 (Spondylolisthesis, lumbar region) (Unlinked to secondary CC/MCC in problem list)
unstructured_op_note_narrative: OPERATIVE REPORT: Two-stage 360-degree circumferential arthrodesis L5-S1. Stage 1: Anterior retroperitoneal approach (ALIF) with complete discectomy and placement of lordotic anterior interbody cage with iliac crest autograft harvest. Patient was then repositioned prone in the same OR session for Stage 2: Open posterior decompression and pedicle screw-rod fixation L5-S1. Total operative time 325 mins.
documented_intraop_complications: Post-op symptomatic hyponatremia & acute blood loss
